chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Itto - Oni Rush for 14 damage, then All Streams Flow to the Sea for 9 damage, both targeting Fuzzy Wurm Crawler. This leaves it at 1 HP.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered using Itto - Oni Rush for 6 Block and playing All Streams Flow to the Sea, preventing the telegraphed 4 damage but dealing only 9 damage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up preventing the incoming 4 damage in exchange for dealing 14 more damage and leaving the enemy at 1 HP.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. A substantially larger attack would have made the 6 Block option more attractive, while a non-attacking intent would strengthen the case for maximizing damage.
